title: Computed structures of core eukaryotic protein complexes
summary: Deep-learning structure modelling screened 8.3 million yeast protein pairs, identified 1505 likely interactions and built models for 106 previously unidentified assemblies and 806 not structurally characterised.
ai_technology: RoseTTAFold and AlphaFold applied to coevolution-paired alignments

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.unknown: Experimental structural confirmation of new assemblies not assessed (abstract only).
evidence.ai_role: Structure predictors scored and modelled candidate pairs.
